extBaseName.description: The main product name (shown large in the header)

extSuffix.description: Badge suffix after the name. Use 'Pro', 'Plus', 'Lite', 'Max', or leave empty string '' to remove it entirely.

extName.description: Full extension name for store listing and browser UI. Keep in sync with extBaseName + extSuffix.

extShortName.description: Short name shown when space is limited (toolbar, etc.)

extDescription.message: Advanced download manager with completion triggers, auto-resume on failure, and smart download queue with concurrent limits. Works on Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera & more.

extTagline.description: Short tagline shown on the welcome page under the title

notifDownloadComplete.description: Notification title when a download finishes

notifDownloadFailed.description: Notification title when a download fails

notifClosingBrowser.description: Notification title for close browser trigger
